title: Credential provider failure during authentication
description: Agent encountered 'Could not load credentials from any providers' error, suggesting the harness did not properly provision or expose credentials to the agent environment.
symptoms: API Error: Could not load credentials from any providers
Agent completed authentication despite credential loading error
root_cause_hint: Harness may not have properly configured credential providers (environment variables, config files, or credential store) for the agent to access during authentication flow.
evidence: API Error: Could not load credentials from any providers
